title: 四点支撑伸出去
description: 成人四点跪撑，伸展对侧手脚，保持背部与骨盆稳定。

art_direction.medium: fine pen and transparent watercolor on warm paper
art_direction.scene: A fictional adult balances on hands and knees on a mat, reaching one arm forward and the opposite leg back to a modest height. The supporting hand is beneath its shoulder, supporting knee beneath the hip, and the pelvis remains level rather than opening upward. Show the fingers spread naturally and the neck aligned with the back. A plain home bookshelf provides a quiet backdrop without any legible book spines. Use layered cardboard diorama illustration with folded architectural planes, readable joints, small material shadows, and beige, aqua, and orange accents. Create one original 1536x1024 wordless scene, fictional fully clothed adults, natural anatomy; no brands, arrows or panels.
